correctness.rationale: Cloitre Proposition 4.3 directly establishes the complement word w=0 product_h(W_h^(x-2)1), W_(h+1)=W_h^k 1. The discrepancy k*zeros-(k-1)*length has total 1 on every W_h and every prefix lies in [1,1+h(k-1)]. On a uniformly sampled complete word, with probability 1-O(k^(-r)), the first h-r recursive child positions are independent uniform 0..k-1 digits; the remainder is O(r), r=floor(h^(1/3)). Classical i.i.d. CLT yields mean (k-1)h/2 and variance (k^2-1)h/12. The stage partition of a uniform global index discards o(N) letters and replaces every good position by a uniform W_m prefix with bounded O(H^(1/3)) deviation and global stage drift (x-k-1)H. Combining yields center (x-2-(k-1)/2)log_k N and the asserted nonzero Gaussian scale for all fixed k>=2,x>=3. Independently checked the word/sequence equivalence for 5 parameter pairs at lengths 2047-3000; these finite words do not establish the CLT.
